reply_text:
㊥ (handed over) Both new seats have their predecessors' jobs. Neither has any memory of the earlier work, so each packet tells them which notes and reports to read first, and gives the branch state commit by commit.
- **codex-18, `psw-proj10`.** The per-application metavariable fix on `psw/ascription-fold` (b99a088e), then the saved lambda patch. Witnesses: `FileMap.ofString`, `Array.back!` and `mkEOIError`.
  - job: `invoke-1791122250897-31703-83910164`
  - park: `park-a2af39c6…`
- **codex-19, `atend-decide2`.** On `psw/prop-bool-coercion` (3e37a458), merge cand-1, then run the real-importer regression that was stopped. Next, cold `atEnd` against its Lean check, and only then the erasure follow-up.
  - job: `invoke-1791122253414-31704-a9acb539`
  - park: `park-ab505484…`

㊟ (seat setup)
- **The packets.** Both include the no-polling rule, so long runs go to `bg.py` and the agent ends its turn.
- **Models.** codex-18's session log shows Sol. codex-19 has no session file yet; its first turn will use the config default, which is Sol. I'll check its log after the first turn.
- **Status.** `rowstatus.json` shows the five rows as theirs again.

previous_reply_acts.text: (why it can't say) The model name isn't in its context unless the harness puts it there, so asking an agent to state its own model is unreliable. The session log is the record.
